```{=html}
<div id="map-aug03" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-aug03').setView([33.3600, 126.3500], 10);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Shilla Stay Jeju Airport', lat:33.48580289503151, lng:126.49091012883574, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Jeju+Airport' },
    { name:'Hallasan Mountain 🏔️', lat:33.3935080462194, lng:126.4939241514017, c:'#5C6BC0', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hallasan+Mountain+Jeju' },
    { name:'Aewol Coastal Road 🌊', lat:33.4628, lng:126.3120, c:'#1976D2', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Aewol+Coastal+Road+Jeju' },
    { name:'Noraba Seafood Ramen 🍜', lat:33.4628, lng:126.3760, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Noraba+Aewol+Jeju' },
    { name:'Comma Cafe ☕', lat:33.39537182155768, lng:126.24196501849201, c:'#AB47BC', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/CrmhGn5exhUnqFXo7' },
    { name:'Osulloc Tea Museum 🍵', lat:33.3061096824764, lng:126.28946382208933, c:'#2E7D32', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Osulloc+Tea+Museum+Jeju' },
    { name:'Jeju Sun Buckwheat Noodles 🍜', lat:33.291441051069796, lng:126.30203636441787, c:'#FFA726', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Jeju+buckwheat+noodles+restaurant' },
    { name:'Yeomiji Botanical Garden 🌸', lat:33.252756083895065, lng:126.41433476441789, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Yeomiji+Botanical+Garden+Jeju' },
    { name:'Myungho Manong Galbi 🥩', lat:33.26191089159834, lng:126.42756219619973, c:'#C62828', url:'https://maps.app.goo.gl/FiMA19wk8jNLkTxt5' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<div class="event-card morning" data-dt="2026-08-03T08:30" data-lat="33.3935080462194" data-lng="126.4939241514017">
  <div class="event-time">08:30</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🏔️ Mountain</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Hallasan Mountain</div>
    <div class="event-notes">~20 min drive straight south from the hotel along the 1100-ro road. Korea's highest peak (1,947m) and a UNESCO World Heritage site — the volcanic heart of Jeju.<br><br>
      The 1100-ro entrance sits at mid-mountain elevation with dramatic views of the crater and surrounding forest. A short walk from the trailhead is enough to feel the scale of the mountain before heading to Aewol.<br><br>
      <div style="background:#FFF3E0;border-left:4px solid #E65100;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:4px;font-size:13px">
        <strong>⚠️ NOTICE — Summit Reservation Required</strong><br>
        Hikers wishing to climb to the summit via the <strong>Seongpanak</strong> or <strong>Gwaneumsa</strong> trails must make a reservation online in advance.<br><br>
        <a href="https://visithalla.jeju.go.kr/main/main.do?language=en_US" target="_blank"><strong>📋 Book Summit Trail → visithalla.jeju.go.kr</strong></a><br><br>
        For reservation assistance: <a href="https://www.visitjeju.net/u/84J" target="_blank">Jeju Tourist Information Center</a> · Open daily 09:00–18:00 KST
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hallasan+Mountain+Jeju+1100-ro" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Hallasan</a>
      <a href="https://map.naver.com/p/search/한라산+1100도로" target="_blank" class="maps-link naver-link">🗺 Naver</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="event-card morning" data-dt="2026-08-03T09:30" data-lat="33.4628" data-lng="126.3120">
  <div class="event-time">09:30</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🌊 Explore</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Aewol Coastal Road — Morning Walk</div>
    <div class="event-notes">~20 min drive from the hotel. Jeju's most scenic coastal stretch — black lava rock coastline, ocean views, and the island's most famous cafe street.<br><br>
      <strong>Things to explore:</strong>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Handam Coastal Trail</strong> — easy 20–30 min paved walk between Gwakji Beach and Handam Village (part of Jeju Olle Trail 16)</li>
        <li><strong>Gwakji Beach</strong> — calm beach famous for its scenery, great morning light</li>
        <li><strong>Aewol Cafe Street</strong> — the most photogenic cafe strip in Jeju; great for a pre-Noraba coffee</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Aewol+Coastal+Road+Jeju" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Aewol Coast</a>
      <a href="https://map.naver.com/p/search/애월해안도로" target="_blank" class="maps-link naver-link">🗺 Naver</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="event-card meal" data-dt="2026-08-03T10:00" data-lat="33.4628" data-lng="126.3760">
  <div class="event-time">10:00</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag meal">🍜 Brunch</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Noraba — Seafood Ramyeon</div>
    <div class="event-notes">🕐 <strong>10:00–17:00 · Break 14:00–15:00 · Closed Thursdays</strong><br>
      Fresh seafood ramyeon loaded with Jeju seasonal catch — crab, abalone, octopus, shrimp, mussels and clams in a mildly spicy broth. The abalone is served live. Ocean views from the window seats on the Aewol Coastal Road.<br><br>
      ⚠️ <strong>Arrive right at opening (10:00)</strong> — 45-min queue is typical once it fills up.
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Noraba+Aewol+Jeju" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Noraba</a>
      <a href="https://map.naver.com/p/search/노라바+애월" target="_blank" class="maps-link naver-link">🗺 Naver</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">🍵 Museum</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Osulloc Tea Museum</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Korea's premier green tea museum set amid rolling tea plantations. Surrounded by Innisfree's green tea fields (same company). Must-try:
      <ul>
        <li>Osulloc green tea ice cream (삼다도 아이스크림)</li>
        <li>Fresh brewed premium green tea</li>
        <li>Tea field walk for photos</li>
      </ul>
      Free admission to museum grounds and gardens. In-store experiences cost extra.
    </div>
    <div class="event-links">
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Osulloc+Tea+Museum+Jeju" target="_blank" class="maps-link">📍 Osulloc</a>

    <div class="event-name">Yeomiji Botanical Garden</div>
    <div class="event-notes">Asia's largest botanical garden with 3,800+ species across themed greenhouses (tropical, subtropical, Mediterranean, desert) and outdoor gardens. The glass pyramids and cactus house are highlights. Entry ~₩14,000. Allow ~1 hour.</div>
```
